sessions.note: The session log proves launch and normal close only.

user_messages.verbatim: 問題なく移動、攻撃、被ダメージ与ダメージを確認しました。ただ、LMBとRMBってなんですか？それだけ気になります。
理解です。攻撃できましたが、撃破後のアイテム回収ができていません。Eもまた未反応です

➀なりませんでした
②確認できました。

qa_prompts.question_1: 黄色いひし形の SALVAGE A/B/C（AVAILABLE）は3つ見えましたか？ その真上まで移動して E を押しても COLLECTED になりませんでしたか？
qa_prompts.question_2: Session Bで、自分の Integrity が0になった後、自分と敵の動作が止まることは確認できましたか？

qa_prompts.question: 回収を試した時、左側の INTEGRITY は0より大きい状態でしたか？

steps: 左 INTEGRITY > 0 を維持してボスを撃破
PHASE WRECK で黄色い SALVAGE A/B/C の各中心へ移動
各点で E をいったん離し、1回だけ押す
3点すべて COLLECTED、その後result表示を確認
可能なら E でrematchし、二周目の移動・攻撃まで確認
終わったらゲームを閉じる
qa_prompts.stop_rule: 失敗した場合はそこで止め、追加の押し直しや再起動は不要。

normalized_direct_observations.observation: Visible movement, generic attack, incoming damage and outgoing damage were observed.
The tester asked what LMB and RMB meant and reported that attack worked after the QA terminology was explained.
A post-defeat collection attempt did not visibly transition to COLLECTED and E appeared unresponsive.
The tester did not affirm that left-side INTEGRITY was greater than zero during the initial collection attempt.
In Session B, the tester confirmed the prompt-level observation that the player and enemy visibly stopped after the displayed Integrity reached zero.

The tester completed every explicitly listed alive-retry step: positive-Integrity boss defeat, WRECK, A/B/C center positioning, one released/fresh E tap at each point, three COLLECTED states, result, rematch, and round-two movement and attack.

qa_and_00_determinations.determination: LMB/RMB was a QA instruction clarity issue. It is not a candidate UI finding.
The first collection observation did not satisfy the positive-Integrity precondition and is non-qualifying for alive harvest acceptance. It is preserved but is not a candidate Fail.
The later positive-Integrity retry did not reproduce an E/collection failure within its explicitly prompted scope. Candidate defect count remains zero.
Automation and source anchors are technical corroboration only and do not upgrade incomplete composite manual rows to Pass.
